evidence_excerpts: Ansor samples complete programs from the space and performs fine-tuning on complete programs, avoiding inaccurate estimation of incomplete programs.
Evolutionary search uses sampled programs and high-quality previous programs as the initial population, applies mutation and crossover, and uses the learned cost model to predict fitness.
text: Sampling complete programs and then fine-tuning them with evolutionary search and a learned cost model avoids inaccurate estimates of incomplete programs.
